### What's new
Report posts that break the rules, and our team can remove them or ban the account. Posting a photo now works with one tap and celebrates with a shower of emojis.

### Ibishya
Ubu ushobora gutanga ikirego ku ifoto inyuranyije n'amabwiriza, itsinda ryacu rikayikuraho cyangwa rigahagarika konti. Gushyiraho ifoto ubu ni ugukanda rimwe, kandi bigahimbazwa n'imbaraga z'ibishushanyo byinshi.

**Install on Android:** open https://github.com/humuraelvin/EcoFun/releases/latest/download/EcoFun.apk on your phone, then tap Install.
